description: This file provides a fake implementation of the runtime API for testing purposes within the Kubernetes project. It includes mock structures and methods to simulate runtime behaviors such as sandbox and container management, status reporting, and metrics collection.

classes.name: FakePodSandbox
classes.description: Represents a fake implementation of a PodSandbox, including runtime status and handler info.

classes.name: FakeContainer
classes.description: Represents a fake container with runtime status, Linux resources, and sandbox association.

classes.name: FakeRuntimeService
classes.description: A mock runtime service implementing methods to simulate container and sandbox operations, status, metrics, and configuration for testing.

methods.name: GetContainerID
methods.description: Retrieves the container ID based on sandbox ID, container name, and attempt number.

methods.name: SetFakeSandboxes
methods.description: Sets the list of fake sandboxes for the runtime service.

methods.name: SetFakeContainers
methods.description: Sets the list of fake containers for the runtime service.

methods.name: AssertCalls
methods.description: Validates whether specific method calls were made to the fake runtime service.

methods.name: GetCalls
methods.description: Returns the list of method calls made to the fake runtime service.

methods.name: InjectError
methods.description: Injects an error to be returned on the next call to a specified method.

methods.name: popError
methods.description: Removes and returns the next error for a given method, if any.

methods.name: NewFakeRuntimeService
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the fake runtime service.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns version information of the fake runtime.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the runtime status.

methods.name: RunPodSandbox
methods.description: Simulates running a pod sandbox, creating a fake sandbox ID and status.

methods.name: StopPodSandbox
methods.description: Simulates stopping a sandbox by changing its state.

methods.name: RemovePodSandbox
methods.description: Removes a sandbox from the fake runtime.

methods.name: PodSandboxStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandbox
methods.description: Lists all sandboxes, optionally filtered.

methods.name: PortForward
methods.description: Simulates port forwarding setup.

methods.name: CreateContainer
methods.description: Creates a fake container within a sandbox.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container, setting its state to running.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container, setting its state to exited.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container from the fake runtime.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers, with optional filtering.

methods.name: ContainerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific container.

methods.name: UpdateContainerResources
methods.description: Updates resources for a container.

methods.name: ExecSync
methods.description: Simulates executing a command synchronously in a container.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Simulates executing a command in a container.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Simulates attaching to a container.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Updates the runtime configuration.

methods.name: SetFakeContainerStats
methods.description: Sets fake container statistics.

methods.name: ContainerStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific container.

methods.name: ListContainerStats
methods.description: Lists container statistics with filtering.

methods.name: SetFakePodSandboxStats
methods.description: Sets fake sandbox statistics.

methods.name: PodSandboxStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxStats
methods.description: Lists sandbox statistics with filtering.

methods.name: ReopenContainerLog
methods.description: Simulates reopening container logs.

methods.name: CheckpointContainer
methods.description: Simulates checkpointing a container.

methods.name: GetContainerEvents
methods.description: Stub for retrieving container events.

methods.name: SetFakeMetricDescriptors
methods.description: Sets fake metric descriptors.

methods.name: ListMetricDescriptors
methods.description: Lists metric descriptors.

methods.name: SetFakePodSandboxMetrics
methods.description: Sets fake sandbox metrics.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxMetrics
methods.description: Lists sandbox metrics.

methods.name: RuntimeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration.

methods.name: UpdatePodSandboxResources
methods.description: Updates sandbox resources.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the fake runtime service connection.
